reflection.text:
The mobile test reported that Wi-Fi was associated but the access point had no complete Ethernet path. Changing the valid address from 192.168.90.30 to 192.168.90.45 did not restore the service.

I connected the AP to switch port 3, then reran the workstation and mobile tests. Both passed. An IP address identifies an interface; it cannot supply a missing physical link. These tests cover this local setup, not Internet access or real clinic authentication.
